_what: The facts about this brand that decide its feedback forms: which forms it gets, when each is sent, and what each event is called in its own systems. Fill each value from the brand's own systems and product facts. Leave a value null until it is known: a form that needs it waits and says so, nothing is assumed. components/feedback-forms/stages.py reads this. An event value may be a list when the brand sells through more than one store or checkout (one flow per source). Each fact may carry a 'source' line saying where it was read.

store_platform.from: the store's admin (e.g. shopify, woocommerce, next-commerce)

email_platform.from: the brand's email account (klaviyo is the one supported today)

has_email_signup.means: people can join the list without buying
has_email_signup.from: the site: a signup form or pop-up

welcome_series_days.means: how many days the welcome emails run after someone joins

checkout_recovery_days.means: how many days the abandoned-checkout emails run

time_to_first_result_days.means: days after delivery before the product shows what it promises
time_to_first_result_days.from: the product facts and claims (products/<product>/product.md), not a guess

buffer_days.means: days to leave after an order or service email before asking anything

joined_list_event.means: the event name(s) when someone joins the list
joined_list_event.from: the email platform's metrics list (Klaviyo's own: 'Subscribed to List')

checkout_started_event.means: the event name(s) when someone starts checkout, one per store or checkout the brand sells through
checkout_started_event.from: the email platform's metrics list, the ones still firing

order_placed_event.means: the event name(s) for a placed order, one per store or checkout
order_placed_event.from: the email platform's metrics list, the ones still firing

delivered_event.means: the event name the email platform receives when an order is delivered
delivered_event.from: the email platform's metrics list (Shopify + Klaviyo: 'Delivered Shipment', if delivery tracking is on)

refund_event.means: the event name for a refund
refund_event.from: the email platform's metrics list (Shopify + Klaviyo: 'Refunded Order')

subscription_renewed_event.means: the event name for a renewal order, as the subscription app sends it
subscription_renewed_event.from: the subscription app's integration with the email platform

subscription_cancelled_event.means: the event name for a cancelled subscription

ticket_resolved_event.means: the event name for a closed support ticket
ticket_resolved_event.from: the helpdesk's integration with the email platform
